description: Unit test class for DeleteAttribute, verifying its immutability, equality, construction, JSON serialization, and parsing.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Tests that DeleteAttribute instances are immutable and that related classes are also immutable.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies correct implementation of hashCode() and equals() for DeleteAttribute.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullThingIdString
methods.description: Checks that creating DeleteAttribute with null thing ID string throws ThingIdInvalidException.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullThingId
methods.description: Checks that creating DeleteAttribute with null ThingId throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullJsonPointers
methods.description: Ensures that passing null JSON pointer raises NullPointerException.

methods.name: createInstanceWithValidArguments
methods.description: Verifies successful creation of DeleteAttribute with valid inputs.

methods.name: createInstanceWithInvalidArguments
methods.description: Checks that invalid JSON pointer input causes JsonKeyInvalidException.

methods.name: createInstanceWithEmptyPointer
methods.description: Ensures that an empty JSON pointer raises AttributePointerInvalidException.

methods.name: toJsonReturnsExpected
methods.description: Validates that the JSON output matches expected structure.

methods.name: createInstanceFromValidJson
methods.description: Tests creation of DeleteAttribute from a valid JSON string.
